title: The Fever Wards
text: A grey fever runs through the tanners' quarter. The physicians want coin for herbs and bread for the sick.

temptation.label: Sell the physicians' herbs to the highest bidder.
temptation.text: Your steward knows a buyer upriver who pays in silver.

triumph.text: The fever breaks within the month.

holds.text: The quarter is quarantined and the fever starves.

falters.text: The fever reaches the Houses' halls.

calamity.text: The dead are burned in the squares for a season.
